ACCEPT — PR #13194 @ `5b944af36f77742b580b1ee55d5b8a23f0590f24` · `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`)

- Clause-②: no. The header-variant layout is internal to `FlowPreview.tsx`; no export or prop moves. No contract review is owed, and the seat read the report.
- Seat review: Ruling 1 was taken as truncate, not wrap. The header variant becomes a one-row grid of `minmax(0, max-content)` columns, so its minimum width is near zero and each pill ellipsizes inside the meta slot instead of being clipped as a whole. The measured row height is unchanged (27px). A pill that is cut adds its whole `Label: value` to its `title`, ahead of the hover text it already carried. An uncut pill keeps its old title, so the existing header pins stay valid. The designer's info bar is not measured and is unchanged.
- Pins: 5 cases cover a truncating Status pill, cut Status and Trigger titles, and two CONTROLs (an uncut pill keeps its title; the bar is not measured). The report records the ablation turning the cut pins red and the restore proven by blob. The pills' existing readers are green.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`.
- CI: all 36 check-runs completed on the head, 33 passed and 3 skipped.
- Path fork: no governed path. Seat landing.
- Findings: Acceptance notes. Studio's `inline-flex min-w-0` wrapper around the meta row would also fit as `max-w-full`. That file is outside this card's surface, and the grid fix makes it unnecessary, so it is left.
- Serial note: objectui#13143 (in flight) edits `FlowPreview.tsx`'s selection title, a different region. It merges `main` after this lands.
